board.name: Maine Board of Licensure in Medicine (or Maine Board of Osteopathic Licensure; PA may be licensed by either)

licence.title: Physician Associate (PA); title changed from physician assistant by PL 2025, c. 316, effective 2025-09-24
licence.renewalDeadline: Last day of birth month; odd birth year renews in odd years, even birth year in even years

ce.categoryRules: At least 50 Category 1 (AAPA, AMA, ACCME, AAFP, MMA, AOA or MOA accredited); up to 50 Category 2; all 100 may be Category 1. Prorated in first licensure period.

topicMandates.appliesTo: BOLIM-licensed PAs: all PAs regardless of whether they prescribe opioids (Ch. 21 §5(1), from 2018-12-31). Osteopathic-board-licensed PAs: as a condition of prescribing opioid medication (Ch. 21 §5(3)). Chapter 2 §11(1)(D) states it for all PAs. Category 1.

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours Category 1 opioid prescribing CME every 2 years
ce.nonCompliance: If the required CME is not completed and submitted, an inactive status licence renewal is issued unless the board granted an extension or deferment (Ch. 2 §11(1)(B)).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Under 4,000 documented clinical hours: collaborative agreement with an active physician, submitted to the board for approval and kept on file at the main practice location; a PA in a physician group practice or health care facility may use its credentialing/privileging and scope of practice agreement instead. On submitting documentation of 4,000 clinical hours the requirement ends. Since 2026-04-03 (PL 2025 c. 604) practice agreements are abolished: PAs over 4,000 documented hours need no agreement in any setting. No fixed periodic renewal of the collaborative agreement found.
practice.notes: Attestation of 4,000 hours submitted to the board ends the collaborative agreement requirement. Jurisprudence exam at application and every other renewal cycle (about 4 years). Joint Rule Chapter 2 posted by the Secretary of State is still the 2020-12-16 version (title physician assistant; still describes practice agreements, which statute no longer provides for).

prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Prescribing (including schedule II to V) is within PA scope under 32 MRSA §3270-G; no separate state prescriptive authority registration found.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 3 hours opioid prescribing CME every 2 years

rn.renewalDeadline: On or before birthday every 2 years; no grace period
rn.ceNote: 32 MRSA §2206 lists no CE condition for RN renewal; no RN contact-hour requirement found.

aprn.title: APRN, Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: APRN licence/approval to practice from the Board of Nursing, renewed concurrently with the RN licence
aprn.ceNote: 50 contact hours per 2-year period in the area of APRN practice; at least 30 Category I; no more than 20 Category II. 50 hours per specialty intent, but overlapping content counts for both.
aprn.pharmacologyNote: No recurring pharmacology hours at renewal. When applying for approval to practice (prescriptive authority), an applicant who has not prescribed in the past 2 years needs 15 pharmacology contact hours within the prior 2 years (45 if not prescribed in 5 years). Initial approval requires 45 pharmacology contact hours.

topicMandates.appliesTo: APRNs with prescriptive authority, as a condition of prescribing opioid medication (Category I; within the 50-hour APRN requirement).

prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Prescriptive authority is part of APRN approval (initial 45 contact hours pharmacology); no separate registration found.
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: None recurring at renewal; 15 hours at application for approval if not prescribed in the past 2 years (45 if not in 5 years).
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours opioid prescribing every 2 years (32 MRSA §2210(4))

practice.transitionNote: 24 months of practice under a registered supervising physician or supervising NP (or employment by a clinic/hospital with a physician medical director) before independent practice; supervising APRN needs 5 years APRN practice in the same specialty.
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Register the supervisory relationship with the board online before practice and before any change; submit written evidence of completing the 24 months. No agreement required after that.
